    sha = hashlib.sha256()

def main():
    import casa_tool
    s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
    c = Controller(s)
    # The grip site's x-axis is the closing direction. Approach with it vertical.
    R = np.array([[0, 0, 1], [0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]])
    c.move(np.array([3.78, -3.12, .714]), R, n=120)
    c.move(np.array([3.929, -3.12, .714]), R, n=70)
    c.hold(25, grip=1)

    # Follow the handle's arc about the actual hinge using an independent IK data buffer.
    p0, R0 = c.pose()
    hinge = s.data.xanchor[c.door].copy()
    axis = s.data.xaxis[c.door].copy()
    q = s.data.qpos[c.qids].copy()
    for i in range(160):
        theta = .52 * (i + 1) / 160
        rot = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis * theta).as_matrix()
        p = hinge + rot @ (p0 - hinge)
        q, err = c.ik(p, rot @ R0, q)
        c.stepq(q)
        if s.check()['success']:
            s.save_trajectory()
            break

    # Continue to the open limit, settle, then release and withdraw the gripper.
    rot = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis * .523).as_matrix()
    c.move(hinge + rot @ (p0 - hinge), rot @ R0, n=50)
    c.hold(60)
    c.hold(25, grip=-1)
    c.move(c.pose()[0] + np.array([-.12, .04, .1]), n=60)
    c.hold(60)
    assert s.check()['success'], s.check()
    path = s.save_trajectory()
    print(path, s.check(), 'door angle', c.angle(), flush=True)
    s.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
